newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera rises strongly on Q4 expectations.
newsitem.headline: Nera rises strongly on Q4 expectations.

text.p: Shares in Norwegian telecommunications group Nera ASA powered ahead on Wednesday as investors remained confident of management forecasts of a good performance in the fourth quarter, dealers said.
At 1041 GMT Nera had gained six crowns, or nearly three percent, to 230 crowns in turnover of 23.4 million crowns.
The stock has risen more than five percent since Nera delivered weaker than expected nine-month results on Monday.

"Third-quarter results were slightly disappointing, but on the other hand their order backlog for the fourth quarter and beyond is strong and the market is predicting tremendous growth in 1997," said an Oslo-based analyst.

If all deliveries in the fourth quarter were fulfilled the company would have revenues for 1996 of around 2.6 billion crowns, he said. Earnings per share were estimated at 9.50 to 10 crowns in 1996, jumping to 15 crowns in 1997.
"Nera has made some impressive presentations despite the third-quarter results. Of course the market is putting its trust in the management, but I see no reason why not to," the analyst said.
